<!-- pr-reviewer: 11df503d119d118bc1631079592c86ed3caaaee3 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** There is one small blocker in the frame-watch excuse (#872). The carry refusal and the wording changes (#873) are sound.

### What looks good
- **The carry refusal still blocks.** `CARRY_TURN_REFUSAL` keeps its name and export (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/mod.rs:113`). In `carry_turn` (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs:118-126`) the error map only rewrites the text. Every arm still returns `Err`, so `setup_stock::carry_refusal` and `SetSetupStockSource` keep refusing (the new side-on test checks the command refusal too).
- **The named turn is the relative turn.** `setup_relative::transform_between` is `compose(a_to, inverse(a_from))` (`setup_relative.rs:115`). The message reads its angles through `setup_align::angles_of`, the same rounding the alignment row uses, so the wording matches the row. The direction is right: "'to' holds the part turned … from how 'from' holds it".
- **The pins prove what they claim.**
  - `both_setups_turned_alike_carry_through_the_identity` would fail if the composition read either setup's own turn, because an absolute X -90° is refused.
  - `a_side_on_turn_between_setups_is_refused_naming_the_turn` refuses, names the turn, and keeps the constant.
- **Every native file dialog goes through the timed seam.** `pick_file`, `save_file` and `pick_folder` all go through `timed` in `file_dialog.rs`. A grep finds no direct `rfd::FileDialog` use outside it. The one other `rfd::` call is `refuse_dialog`'s `MessageDialog` (`shell_window.rs:289`), which runs at GPU-init refusal outside any frame, so it does not matter here.
- **"furniture" is gone from the setup Settings page and the Setups page footer.** The new radio label is true: the Stock page and the WCS page both edit the active setup.
- **Process.** No PNGs changed, no `unwrap`/`expect`, and there are no new modules (so no provenance lines are needed). The `Changelog:` line is present, the body ends with `Fixes #872` / `Fixes #873` / `Refs #866`, and the commit subject is conventional. The decision file is `docs/decisions/866-setup2-carry.md`.

### Local results (macOS, trial-merged with upstream main - already up to date, no conflicts)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `setup_stock_source` | 8 passed |
| app `setup_carry` | 9 passed |
| app `carried_verify` | 8 passed |
| app `--lib` | 108 passed |
| sim `stock_carry` | 7 passed |
| sim `--lib` | 69 passed |
| ui `--lib frame_watch` (CWD crates/ui) | 4 passed |
| ui `--lib setup_stock` (CWD crates/ui) | 4 passed |
| ui `--lib` full (CWD crates/ui) | 515 passed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
1. **Dialogs opened during the "ui" phase are taken off the wrong frame, which hides real work.**

   `take_waited()` is drained only before `mark("commands")` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/frame.rs:38`). Some dialogs open straight from panel draw code, inside the frame's "ui" phase, not from `drain_actions`:
   - `state.export_tool_library_dialog()` / `import_tool_library_dialog()`: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:998` and `:1001`
   - `state.import_tool_body_dialog()`: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:74`

   Scenario: the user clicks "Import…" on the Tools page and browses for 30 s.
   - That frame still logs `slow frame 30000 ms … slowest phase "ui"`. This is the same false freeze #872 fixes, now under another phase.
   - The 30 s then stays in `WAITED_US` until the next frame. That frame's `excuse(30 s)` moves `start` and `last` 30 s past `now`, so `mark("commands")` and `end()` saturate to 0. Real work in that next frame (for example a slow re-collect after the import) is never reported.

   That breaks the "real work beyond it still does" half of #872's "Done means". Fix: drain at the end of each phase that can open a dialog, i.e. also call `frame_watch.excuse(crate::file_dialog::take_waited())` just before `frame_watch.mark("ui", now())` (`frame.rs:159`). A simpler alternative is to have `FrameWatch::mark` take the waited time itself. Either way, add a test that excuses a wait inside the "ui" phase. You could also clamp `excuse` so `start`/`last` never pass the current instant. That keeps a stray carry-over from wiping out a whole frame.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `frame.rs` is now 411 lines (it was already over ~400; +2 here). Worth splitting along a seam in a later change.
- "furniture" is still in other user-facing errors, outside #873's Settings-page scope:
  - `project/validate.rs:122` ("reserved for setup furniture")
  - `project/validate.rs:277`
  - `commands/fixture.rs:91`
  - the `repair_model` MCP tool description (`mcp/model_tools.rs:36`)

  A follow-up issue for these would finish the job.
- On #866 the reporter wrote "It seems to work if I don't select Face Down." A face-down flip over X is a carryable turn, so their Setup2 may hold a compound turn (face down plus a side turn). The new message names the relative angles, so it should show which turn is the problem. It may be worth confirming with them once this ships.
- The identity pin checks that the carry is accepted, not what volume is carried. That is fine for this PR, since `setup_carry` covers the carried body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8ccb49796d4febd46d86e381063e2274f6e4bbe3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a delta review of `11df503d..8ccb4979`. It resolves the one blocker from the previous review (dialog waits during the "ui" phase).

### What looks good
- **The ui-phase wait is now collected at the ui boundary.** `frame.rs:160` drains `take_waited()` just before `mark("ui")`, the same way `frame.rs:38` does before `mark("commands")`. I traced every dialog call site:
  - The ones opened straight from panel draw code (`pages.rs:998`/`:1001`, `tool_body_page.rs:74`) run inside the "ui" phase.
  - Everything else (open model/project, save, post, sheet/STL/tool-list export, vise/plate/accessory, the unsaved-changes Save) goes through `state.pending`. Those run in `drain_actions` in the "commands" phase.
  - Nothing after `mark("ui")` opens a dialog. `acquire`/`encode`/`submit+present` only touch the camera, the field view and the GPU.
  - `window_event`'s `CloseRequested` only queues `Quit`.
  - No wait carries into the next frame any more.
- **`excuse(waited, now)` now clamps the shift to `now - last`.** So neither stamp can pass the current instant, and a stray carry-over can no longer wipe out the earlier phases of a frame.
- **The "furniture" rewording is accurate.** `is_furniture_name` covers the setup's stock and its work offsets (the legacy `Stock`/`G54..G59` and their per-setup private names), so each of these now matches what the check refuses:
  - "reserved for the setup's stock or work offsets" (`project/validate.rs:122`)
  - "empty stock or work-offset name" (`validate.rs:277`, which checks `s.stock` / the WCS names)
  - "the setup's stock, work offset or CAM data" (`commands/fixture.rs:91`)
  - the `repair_model` MCP description
- **Process is fine.** The commit subject is conventional, and the delta has no snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no process files, no `build.rs`/scripts/`.github`/dependency changes. It adds no `unwrap`/`expect`.

### Local results (macOS, trial-merged with upstream main: already up to date, no conflicts; private target)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| app `repair_model` | 4 passed |
| app `setup_stock_source` | 8 passed |
| ui `--lib frame_watch` (CWD crates/ui) | 5 passed |
| ui `--lib setup_stock` (CWD crates/ui) | 4 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. **The new pin does not tell the clamp apart.** I swapped `excuse` back to the unclamped shift (`let shift = waited;`) in my local review copy and re-ran the tests: `a_wait_inside_the_ui_phase_is_excused_and_the_next_frame_is_clean` still passes, and so do the other four `frame_watch` tests. The pin checks the `FrameWatch` arithmetic, which was already right. The real fix is the wiring in `frame.rs:160`, and that is windowed-shell code with no headless test, so this is expected. Its last block cannot catch a missing clamp, because the over-long excuse comes straight after `begin`, before any phase has run. One case that would catch it: `begin(t)`, `mark("commands", t+200ms)`, `excuse(5 s, t+210ms)`, `mark("ui", t+210ms)`. Then `end` must still report the 200 ms commands phase. Without the clamp, `start` moves past `now` and the frame reads as 0 ms. This is optional hardening.
2. **"Setup furniture" is still in user-facing errors.** These are `CommandError` texts that reach the status line and MCP errors:
   - `commands/repair_model.rs:47` "'{name}' is setup furniture, not a model". The `repair_model` MCP description now says "the setup's stock or work offsets", but the error it returns still says "setup furniture". `tests/repair_model.rs:82` asserts the old text.
   - `commands/update_model.rs:81` (same text)
   - `commands/tool.rs:32` "reserved for setup furniture"
   - `commands/setup.rs:95` "that separator belongs to setup furniture"
   - `commands/setup.rs:109` "reserved for setup furniture"

   The rest are comments and doc comments (`state.rs`, `fixture.rs`, `entity.rs`, `validate.rs:49`, `tool.rs:19`, `import_fixture.rs`, `tool_import.rs`, `update_model.rs:67`). These are outside #873's scope. A small follow-up issue would finish the rewording.
3. `frame.rs` is now 413 lines (it was already over ~400; +2 here). It is still worth a split along a seam later.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
